prompt:
Create an animation sprite sheet from this approved sleeping whale-maid reference. Eight SMALL stickers arranged in exactly 4 columns and 2 rows on transparent alpha, landscape 2:1 canvas. Critical layout: each sticker occupies ONLY the CENTRAL 65% of an equal square grid cell. There must be LARGE CLEAR TRANSPARENT GAPS between every sticker, and large clear margins outside. All eight COMPLETE figures INCLUDING each full whale fluke fit within their cells. No tail touching another cell or canvas edge. Make the stickers noticeably SMALL, surrounded by empty space. Same scale and anchor in all eight frames. No labels, no grid, no text, no backgrounds, no cast shadows.
Animate a tiny seamless eight-phase sleeping breathing cycle, not eight different poses: reference pose stays exactly the same, eyes always closed, pillow and legs anchored; gently lift and settle shoulders and blanket a tiny amount. Character matches reference exactly, detailed anime chibi blue whale maid, navy short gold-embroidered skirt, white lace, blue blanket, cream pillow.
Preserve the correct tail connection in ALL EIGHT frames: the ONE rounded blue tail stem emerges from UNDER the white lace short-skirt hem, its root is hidden INSIDE the skirt; it curves behind the legs into a two-lobed whale fluke. Do not attach tail to hair or outer waist. Do not lengthen skirt or add extra tails. Clean transparent edges.
notes: 前两次八帧候选的尾鳍越过分格边界，未采用。此稿经 alpha 边界检查后用于房间睡眠动画。
